question: Should this draft merge under a monitored proof override for the first naturally occurring failed shard, or remain paused until staging/shadow evidence is available?
rationale: The patch and focused tests are strong, but the affected production control-plane path cannot be exercised safely before deployment without manufacturing workflow failure or load; accepting that evidence gap and owning rollback is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Approve monitored canary override
options.body: Merge under an explicit proof override, observe only the first natural failed shard, capture redacted queue/run evidence for every stated invariant, and revert immediately if any invariant fails.

options.title: Hold for stronger proof
options.body: Keep the PR in draft until staging, shadow execution, or another safe environment demonstrates the complete recovery path without touching live workflow state.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored canary override
recommendation.body: Merge under an explicit proof override, observe only the first natural failed shard, capture redacted queue/run evidence for every stated invariant, and revert immediately if any invariant fails.
